question.prompt:
Two adjacent lateral faces of a rectangular prism are both perpendicular to the base. How many lateral edges perpendicular to the base lie in one of these lateral faces (count only that face's own lateral edges)?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h122_q3_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: A lateral face is a rectangle, and its left and right lateral edges are both perpendicular to the base.
solutions.title: Count the face's lateral edges
